newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end higher on late buying.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end higher on late buying.

text.p: Shanghai's foreign currency B shares rose slightly on Monday after a late spurt of buying lifted the index out of negative territory, brokers said.
But a holiday in Hong Kong limited both foreign and Hong Kong demand, which had helped push B shares sharply higher on Thursday and Friday, they said.
The B index closed up 0.748 point or 0.85 percent to 88.424 on turnover of $30.000 million compared with $65.159 million on Friday.
